# Normalization

Canonical and compatibility decomposition, and the NFD, NFC, NFKD and NFKC normal forms.

<h2 id="hangul-base"><code>HangulBase</code></h2>

```rux
pub const HangulBase: uint32 = 0xAC00;
```

The first Hangul syllable, LV and LVT composition's base.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Normalize.rux#L17)

<h2 id="decompose-canonical"><code>DecomposeCanonical</code></h2>

```rux
pub func DecomposeCanonical(
    text: char32[..],
    into: var char32[..],
    written: *var uint
) -> bool
```

Writes the canonical decomposition of `text` into `into`, marks in canonical order: NFD.
Reports the length through `written`, or `false` without a defined result when the room is short. The
decompositions are fully expanded in the tables, so nothing recurses.
`written` must be non-null and writable.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Normalize.rux#L112)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                           |
| --------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `text`    | `char32[..]`     | the scalar values to decompose        |
| `into`    | `var char32[..]` | receives the decomposition            |
| `written` | `*var uint`      | receives how many values were written |

**Returns**: false without writing when `into` is too short

<h2 id="decompose-compatibility"><code>DecomposeCompatibility</code></h2>

```rux
pub func DecomposeCompatibility(
    text: char32[..],
    into: var char32[..],
    written: *var uint

```

Writes the compatibility decomposition of `text` into `into`, marks in canonical order: NFKD.
`written` must be non-null and writable.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Normalize.rux#L123)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                           |
| --------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `text`    | `char32[..]`     | the scalar values to decompose        |
| `into`    | `var char32[..]` | receives the decomposition            |
| `written` | `*var uint`      | receives how many values were written |

**Returns**: false without writing when `into` is too short

<h2 id="normalize-canonical"><code>NormalizeCanonical</code></h2>

```rux
pub func NormalizeCanonical(
    text: char32[..],
    into: var char32[..],
    written: *var uint
) -> bool
```

Writes the NFC of `text` into `into`: canonical decomposition, canonical order, then composition.
`written` must be non-null and writable.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Normalize.rux#L238)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                           |
| --------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `text`    | `char32[..]`     | the scalar values to normalize        |
| `into`    | `var char32[..]` | receives the normalized form          |
| `written` | `*var uint`      | receives how many values were written |

**Returns**: false without writing when `into` is too short

<h2 id="normalize-compatibility"><code>NormalizeCompatibility</code></h2>

```rux
pub func NormalizeCompatibility(
    text: char32[..],
    into: var char32[..],
    written: *var uint
) -> bool
```

Writes the NFKC of `text` into `into`: compatibility decomposition, canonical order, then composition.
`written` must be non-null and writable.

[Source](https://github.com/rux-lang/Rux/blob/main/Packages/Unicode/Src/Normalize.rux#L252)

**Parameters**

| Name      | Type             | Description                           |
| --------- | ---------------- | ------------------------------------- |
| `text`    | `char32[..]`     | the scalar values to normalize        |
| `into`    | `var char32[..]` | receives the normalized form          |
| `written` | `*var uint`      | receives how many values were written |

**Returns**: false without writing when `into` is too short
